create_ped_solver: create a PED solver instance with configurable learning rates, projection, and random initialization
compute_gradients_ped: compute exploitability gradients for a population distribution over strategy profiles in a non-symmetric game
run_mirror_descent_step: run entropic mirror descent update step on strategy distributions given gradients
run_euc_descent_step: run projected gradient descent step with Euclidean simplex projection on strategy distributions
compute_exploitability: compute unregularized exploitability of current strategy distributions against best responses
